nodes.name: === Changelog ===
nodes.info:
### 2026-09-14b
- `evaluate` now gates the `bms_health` Influx write on each field's own `_ts` (`TH.stale_write_ms`, 5 min). `flow.bms_state` latches every field indefinitely, so a dark pack kept answering with its last value and the writer recorded it once per tick as freshly measured: `bat_west` logged a flat `soc_percent=38.31` and `current=-2.3 A` from 05:30Z to 09:00Z straight through the BLE outage. On a graph that reads as a pack sitting perfectly still, not as missing data, and anything averaging `bms_health` across banks ate the stale value whole. `comm_dropout` had been alerting on the same pack the entire time - the alert fired while the writer kept fabricating the series. The gate is per-field, not per-bank, so one dead field cannot ride in on a sibling that is still updating; 5 min is looser than `comm_dropout_ms` so a single missed 60 s BLE poll does not punch holes. Alert conditions still read the latched values - unchanged here, and `socbms` is unaffected (it comes from `global.bms`).

### 2026-09-14
- `capture` now keeps a stale pack's cell voltages in `minCellV`/`maxCellV` for up to 6 h (`VOLT_FRESH_MS`), gated on each voltage record's own `_ts` rather than on the pack's SOC freshness, and reports the dropped packs as `global.bms.voltOnlyPacks`. `bat_west` went dark for 4h15m on 2026-09-14 behind a stale BlueZ GATT cache (`org.bluez.Error.NotPermitted: Notify acquired`, cleared by `bluetoothctl remove`), and because the `FRESH_MS` check `continue`d before the voltage reads, the pack left the gates entirely: `minCellV` published `bat_ost`'s 3.322 V while `bat_west` - lowest pack in the fleet at 41.4% against 50.1/54.3, and so the first to reach the LFP knee - was invisible to the floor that exists to protect it. Min/max across packs only move the fleet extremes outward, so a stale reading can only tighten both gates, never loosen them. The 6 h bound is there because a sag latched at the wrong moment would otherwise jam no-discharge for as long as the pack stayed dark.
- Recorded while fixing the above: `global.ess.Soc` read **21%** against a true weighted 50.7%, and the offset EMA seeded at **29.4 pp** on its first all-banks sample. The offset only samples when `nBanks === 3`, so it had never been measured while `bat_west` was down - had the whole feed died in that window, `query_soc` would have fallen through to the uncorrected 21%.

### 2026-09-12
- `capture` now publishes `global.bms.minCellV` (min `cell_voltages/min` across fresh packs) alongside `maxCellV`, and `frozenPacks`. The optimizer had a `CELL_FULL_V` ceiling but nothing at the bottom, so the only thing standing between the pack and over-discharge was the SOC number - which runs optimistic down there. On the night of 2026-09-11 `bat_ost`'s minimum cell fell to 3.176 V (the bottom of the LFP knee) while it still reported 25.2% and the weighted feed said ~35%; Victron read 6%.
- `capture` now drops a pack from the SOC average once its coulomb counter freezes. `bat_west` republishes a stale `soc/soc_percent` for hours - pinned at 46.4% from 19:00 to 06:00 UTC on 2026-09-12, and at 47.5% for five hours over midday - while its own ammeter integrated 88.8 Ah into the pack for a registered +1.1 pp. The `FRESH_MS` check cannot see this: the stale value keeps arriving with a fresh `_ts`, so the frozen pack stayed in the weighted average at full weight. Detection integrates each pack's own `soc/current` between its `soc_percent` messages (`flow.bms_socmove`) and distrusts the pack once >2% of its capacity has moved with SOC unchanged - ~20 min at 7 A on `bat_west`. Trickle below 1 A is ignored, since a flat SOC is honest there, and the dt is capped at 15 min so a restart or broker gap cannot bank hours of charge.
- Cell voltages are kept from every fresh pack, frozen or not: they are measured rather than integrated, so a stuck counter says nothing about them - and they are exactly what the new bottom guard runs on.

### 2026-06-28b
- `capture` now also publishes `global.bms.maxCellV` (max `cell_voltages/max` across fresh packs). The optimizer gates grid-charge on cell voltage rather than the miscalibrated SOC%, so bat_big can fill while the small packs sit at ~3.40 V.

### 2026-06-28
- `capture` now also publishes a capacity-weighted aggregate SOC to `global.bms` ({weightedSoc, maxPackSoc, ts, oldestTs}), weighting each bank's `soc/soc_percent` by `soc/aged_capacity` and skipping packs whose reading is >30 min stale. Consumed by the Battery Controller v2 optimizer as a trustworthy replacement for the jumpy Victron SOC.

### 2026-05-12
- Iter4o: light grey chart text on dark dashboard. First tried CSS targeting SVG `text` — ineffective because Node-RED dashboard 3.6.6 uses Chart.js 2.3 (canvas-rendered, not styleable by CSS). Replaced with a `<script>` in `mon_ui_dark_css` that sets `Chart.defaults.global.defaultFontColor = #b0b0b0`, dims gridlines to rgba(255,255,255,0.08), and walks `Chart.instances` to update legend/axis ticks on existing charts. Polls for 2 min to catch late-loaded charts after refresh.

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4n: fix group ordering so the Refresh button actually appears on top. Dashboard 1 treats order=0 as unset and pushes the group to the bottom. Shifted all bb_grp_* orders up by one: ctrl=1, ess=2, ost=3, west=4, big=5.

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4m: ESS card compacted to a single-row layout (height 7 -> 3, stats inline next to the ESS label). Refresh button widened to fill its group (width 4 -> 14) so it's a full-width bar at the top of the tab. Group order unchanged (ctrl=0, ess=1, banks=2-4).

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4l: ESS card bigger and moved below Refresh button. Card height 4 -> 7 grid units; stat font 16 -> 26px; title 20 -> 26px; thicker left accent (4 -> 6px) and more padding. Groups reordered: ctrl=0 (Refresh), ess=1 (ESS card), ost=2, west=3, big=4.

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4k: ESS header card at top of Batteries tab, above the bank cards. `bb_publish` gains a 4th output emitting ESS payload from `global.ess` (Soc, Voltage, Power, AcPowerSetPoint, acload, pac); new `bb_tpl_ess` ui_template renders it. New `bb_grp_ess` group at order 0; existing groups renumbered ctrl=1, ost=2, west=3, big=4. Power and AC Setpoint are color-coded by sign (green positive, amber negative); other fields neutral.

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4j: chart now overlays SOC as a third series. Query fetches MEAN(soc_percent); format scales SOC% to the cell voltage Y axis with y = 2.8 + (SOC/100) * 0.8 so 0% sits at 2.8V and 100% at 3.6V — same range as cell operating window. Series label includes current SOC: "SOC 67% (scaled)". Color soft purple (#ba68c8) to stand apart from min cyan / max gold.

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4i: header now also shows SOC% and Power, alongside total voltage and current. Power uses the same charge/discharge color as current (green when positive = charging, amber when negative = discharging). SOC stays neutral white.

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4h: chart legend now shows the current min/max cell number, e.g. "min (cell 8)" / "max (cell 2)". `bb_chart_format` reads `flow.bms_state` for the latest `cell_voltages/min_index` and `cell_voltages/max_index` per bank and injects them into the ui_chart series names. No schema change.

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4f: fix `bb_chart_query` to use `influxdb_config` (db=tmp) — the bms_health measurement is written to `tmp`, not `infra` as the node name suggested. Note: `cb_trend_query` reads from `infra` so the trend pipeline has been silently empty; not changed here, flagged for follow-up.

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4e: 48h cell min/max line chart per bank. New `bb_chart_query` (influxdb in, 48h MEAN(cell_min/cell_max) GROUP BY time(15m), bank FILL(none)) -> `bb_chart_format` (function, 3 outputs) -> per-bank `bb_chart_<bank>` (ui_chart, line, order 2 inside each bank group, sits below the cell grid). Refreshes on each 180s `cb_cron` tick and on Refresh button click.

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4d: manual refresh. New `bb_grp_ctrl` ui_group at top of Batteries tab with a `bb_btn_refresh` ui_button ("↻ Refresh") wired into `bb_publish`. Click fires the publish function on demand without waiting for the 180s tick.

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4c: dashboard publish now reuses the 180s `cb_cron` tick — dedicated `bb_pub_cron` removed. Dashboard cards refresh on the same cadence as the evaluator (every 3 minutes, wall-clock aligned to 0/3 min).

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4b: dark card theme, white text. Per-cell tile now shows signed deviation from bank avg as the dominant value (large), with voltage below. Header now carries total voltage + current next to bank name (current colored green when charging, amber when discharging). Min cell border cyan, max cell border gold.

### 2026-05-11
- Iter4: dashboard visualization. New "Batteries" tab, one card per bank stacked vertically.
- `bb_pub_cron` (cronplus, 5s) -> `bb_publish` (function, 3 outputs) -> per-bank `bb_tpl_<bank>` (ui_template).
- `bb_publish` reads `flow.bms_state`, computes per-cell severity (ok/warn/crit) using same thresholds as `cb_evaluate`: cell_under <2.80V / cell_over >3.60V => crit; |v - bank_avg| > 30mV => warn. Delta severity: <50mV ok, 50-100mV warn, >=100mV crit. Temps outside [-10,50]C and MOSFET >60C => crit. Switches not ON => crit. Comm dropout >3min dims the card and shows STALE banner.
- Each card: header (bank name + age), summary grid (SOC, voltage, current, power, cycles, delta, T1/T2/MOSFET, min/max/avg cell), switch chips, 4x4 cell tile grid (idx + voltage, color-coded; min cell border blue, max cell border red).

### 2026-05-05
- Iter3: debounce + trend.
- Per-condition debounce in `cb_evaluate`. Statistical checks (cell_delta_warn/alert, cell_outlier_*, temp_high/low_*, mosfet_temp_high) require 3 consecutive ticks (~9min @ 180s) before flipping state. Safety-critical checks (no_data, comm_dropout, cell_under, cell_over, switch_charge_off, switch_discharge_off) emit `active` immediately, require 3 clear ticks to resolve. Events (bms_reboot, cycles_reset) stay one-shot.
- Trend pipeline: `cb_trend_cron` (cronplus, hourly @ HH:05) -> `cb_trend_query` (influxdb in, raw output, 1h-bucketed MEDIAN of cell_delta over 24h GROUP BY bank) -> `cb_trend_eval` (linear regression of slope, mV/day) -> `cb_alert_out`. Threshold 5 mV/day; needs >=6 hourly buckets.

### 2026-05-05
- Iter2: monitoring pipeline. cron-plus tick @ 180s aligned -> cb_evaluate -> alert MQTT (`checkbattery/alert`) + InfluxDB `infra.bms_health`.
- Health checks: comm dropout (3min), cell delta warn/alert (50/100mV), cell hard limits (2.8/3.6V), per-cell outlier (30mV from bank avg), temperatures 1+2 (-10/50C, sensors 3/4 ignored), MOSFET temp (60C), switch charge/discharge OFF, BMS reboot, cycle counter monotonic.
- InfluxDB metrics per bank: soc_percent, total_voltage, current, power, balance_current, num_cycles, cell_delta/min/max/avg, capacity_ah, mosfet_temp, temp1, temp2.
- Alerts emit only on state transitions (active / cleared) -- no per-tick spam.

### 2026-05-05
- Bootstrap: subscribe to bat_ost, bat_west, bat_big at central MQTT broker; capture last payload per leaf-topic into `global.checkbattery_samples` for schema discovery.
